scientific_question: Does calibrated_lr3e4, the project's overall champion at the end of camp-20260805, keep improving when given further 20-epoch segments from its own best checkpoint?
declared_by: project owner, 2026-08-10: continue training calibrated_lr3e4, same continuation rules as camp-20260805 (resume from best, 20-epoch segments, advance/stop on the 6-epoch improvement window)
boundary: Optimization evidence on the pilot bank only. Establishes nothing about Geant4 fidelity, three-seed behaviour, or untouched-test performance. The 76,300-event test split stays sealed and is not read by training, diagnostics, or visualization.
improvement_rule: after a segment, continue the same family when latest_epoch - best_epoch <= improvement_window, otherwise stop -- there is no next family in this single-family chain
patience_rule: early_stopping_patience equals the segment horizon. A constant patience counts staleness against an inherited best reached at the end of an anneal and stopped dicos-p8 at 6 of 24 epochs.
scheduler_rule: restart_scheduler_on_resume is false. CosineAnnealingLR is periodic in 2*T_max, so a continued cosine climbs back toward peak by itself; that produced dicos-p9's 0.067 improvement where a restart produced nothing.
resume_rule: resume from the parent BEST checkpoint on both resume slots, hash-verified before a weight is loaded.
closure_tolerance_note: Unchanged from camp-20260805: the energy-scaled closure tolerance declared 2026-08-05 is already baked into the parent template this segment continues from. See audit/closure_tolerance_20260805_terminal_analysis.json.

calibrated_lr3e4.note: dicos-c-02 is the family's live run: camp-20260805's first attempt (dicos-c-01) aborted on the producer-path/shard-cache bug fixed that same session, and dicos-c-02 was the successful restart from the same parent (dicos-p7 best, epoch 22). dicos-c-02's own best is epoch 34 (4.550331), 8 epochs behind its own latest observed epoch (42-43), which is why camp-20260805 advanced past it to calibrated_lr1e4_halfbatch rather than continuing it further. This plan resumes exactly where that decision left off.

excluded.calibrated_lr1e4: not part of this plan. 39 epochs, the most of any family; its dicos-p10 epoch-40 checkpoint is ARTIFACT QUARANTINED and is not a valid parent.
excluded.calibrated_lr1e4_halfbatch: not part of this plan. Already carried forward by camp-20260805 to dicos-c-03 (best epoch 33, 4.619967); untouched here.
excluded.calibrated_lr3e5: not part of this plan. Already carried forward by camp-20260805 to dicos-c-05 (best epoch 36, 4.702203); untouched here.

lineage_note: Scoped to calibrated_lr3e4 only, per the owner's 2026-08-10 instruction to continue that specific family. The other three calibrated families are left exactly where camp-20260805 left them.
